title: b7z9.40(c): raw TX rejects PHY/regulatory constraint violations (R-11-028)
description: Child of b7z9.40. spec/11-lci.md 17.5.4 R-11-028: raw TX MUST reject frames/overrides violating configured PHY/regulatory constraints. Today Python caps frame length only (raw_tx.py:51); there is no radio-override validation surface; Rust HAL TxPower caps are unwired primitives (rust/lichen-hal/src/lib.rs:223-262). Design needed: define the constraint surface (region TX-power caps, duty cycle, datarate/modulation bounds) and a validation seam in the raw TX path; tests for violating overrides. Largest child; needs a constraint-surface design decision — flag to Mark if the regulatory model is ambiguous.
